methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
ESCAP's institutional repository (repository.unescap.org) is a DSpace 7 instance exposing the standard HAL/REST discovery API. It holds ~9,300+ items and is the preferred structured ingestion path over the unescap.org/publications HTML pages.

## Search
GET /server/api/discover/search/objects with the term in `query`. Items are at `_embedded.searchResult._embedded.objects[]._embedded.indexableObject`, each with `uuid`, `name`, and a Dublin-Core `metadata` map. `sort=dc.date.issued,DESC` is verified. Total is `_embedded.searchResult.page.totalElements` (9,335 for a broad query).

## Filters
The discovery facets endpoint (/server/api/discover/facets) confirms these live facet names: dateIssued, country, unbist, unsdg, type, author, pow, aow, series, contactUnit, has_content_in_original_bundle, language, subject_AAT, type_AAT, format_medium. Apply with `&f.<facet>=<value>,equals`. Verified example: `f.type=Report,equals` narrowed to 2,608 hits and the response echoed the applied filter. Date range: `f.dateIssued.min` / `f.dateIssued.max`.

## Download
PDFs are in the ORIGINAL bundle. Resolve GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid}/bundles -> ORIGINAL -> bitstreams -> /server/api/core/bitstreams/{bitstreamUuid}/content. Pre-filter downloadable items with `f.has_content_in_original_bundle=true,equals`.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Search hits carry dc.* plus ESCAP-specific escap.* fields, UN BIS subjects (dc.subject.unbist) and SDG tags. Note dc.language.iso here uses ISO-3 codes ('eng'), unlike FAO. Handle URIs point to hdl.handle.net/20.500.12870/*. GET /server/api/core/items/{uuid} for full record.

## Limitations
Unauthenticated access worked with a plain browser User-Agent (no Referer needed, unlike FAO). Pagination is zero-based `page`/`size`; DSpace typically caps size at 100.
